entities.name: Rendmaw
entities.description: Wickerfolk of Duskmourn formed from a ritual circle's participants woven together by wood, psychically bonded with a murder of crows.

entities.name: Murder of crows
entities.description: Flock altered by the House to crave living meat that bonded with Rendmaw.

entities.name: the House
entities.description: Force whose influence altered the crows.

events.summary: Ritualists altering a wicker transformation spell were woven together into the singular entity Rendmaw.
events.quote: binding the ritualists into a singular entity of branches and living beings

events.summary: A murder of crows fed on the humans bound to Rendmaw, creating a psychic bond.
events.quote: Feeding on the humans bound to Rendmaw's body created a psychic bond
